title: Co-borrower liability disputes - the common misconceptions
p1:
Many people believe a co-borrower is only responsible for their share of a loan.

That belief can create serious surprises when repayment problems begin.
p2:
The common misconception is that if one co-borrower stops paying, the lender can only pursue that person. In reality, co-borrowers are usually responsible for the entire outstanding loan amount, not just the portion they used.

A co-borrower may have contributed less money or may not have benefited equally from the loan, but the lender's rights can still extend to all borrowers.
p3:
The key insight: responsibility to the lender and fairness between co-borrowers are two different issues. One co-borrower may have to repay the lender first and later seek recovery from the other borrower.

Before signing as a co-borrower, understand that you are accepting a financial obligation, not just supporting someone else's application.
conclusion: Did you know a co-borrower can sometimes be held responsible for the full loan amount? What has been your experience with co-borrower liability disputes?
